content brief: Show Blank Model, save as PitchRateLimiter_Lab.slx in the authorized location, attach data/FCS_Data.sldd, and set fixed-step discrete, FixedStep = Sample_time, StartTime = 0, StopTime = 4, and signal logging = on. Include both GUI and MATLAB alternatives.
speaker-note brief: Use Do / Expect / Recover. Explain that the shared dictionary may be inspected but not edited for the practice model; initialization writes managed entries. Provide the exact set_param configuration reflected by configureDiscreteModel and cite create_training_models.m and FCS_Data.sldd.

content brief: Use the authentic PitchRateLimiter model as the target. Number the required elements: q_cmd_in double deg/s port 1, normal_mode boolean port 2, input_valid boolean port 3, Pitch Rate Limiter Logic subsystem, q_cmd_out double deg/s port 1, and limiter_active boolean port 2.
speaker-note brief: Give exact block library locations, port numbers, types, units, Sample_time use, and required names. Expected result is a shell that matches the reviewed interface before internal logic is added. Explain recovery from incorrect port order or inherited data types.

title: Step 3 — implement the clamp, fallback, and active-status logic
content brief: Use the authentic subsystem image with numbered construction order: Normal AND Valid, Magnitude Clamp, Training Fallback Command, Select Valid Command, positive/negative limit comparisons, Outside Inclusive Range, and Valid Clamp Active. Show the key block parameters.
speaker-note brief: Specify Saturation limits ±q_limit_normal, fallback q_fallback_command, Switch criteria u2 ~= 0 and threshold 0.5, strict > and < active comparisons, and no delay/state. Explain inclusive-boundary behavior and give expected outputs for 12, 12.1, invalid, and non-normal inputs.

content brief: Make the demonstration deterministic in the lab copy: choose a line whose starting logging state is stated, turn logging on, run, confirm the signal in logsout or SDI, then remove it if the lab requires rollback. Show test-point status separately and do not save changes to the delivered baseline.

Contrast logging with optimization-resistant observability, describe test-point tradeoffs, and provide recovery/no-save instructions. Cite the saved package logging inventory and MathWorks documentation.

Verify active configuration, fixed-step discrete solver, fixed-step expression, logging, diagnostics, model reference, hardware, and code-generation panes. State when to Apply/OK, when not to save, and which evidence must be rerun after an authorized change.
